source.title: 127. Milosrđe Božje - Isus Krist jest Gospodin na slavu Boga Oca!

summary.title_hr: 127. Milosrđe Božje - Isus Krist jest Gospodin na slavu Boga Oca!
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda je molitveno-katehetska emisija kanala Oraetlabora Međugorje, koju je prema opisu pripremio dr. sc. Vladimir Grebenar. Prvi i najduži dio čine molitve: zaziv zaštite i oslobođenja, posvete Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu, krunica i litanije Božjeg milosrđa te žalosna otajstva Gospine krunice sa Zdravo Kraljice. U tumačenju čitanja iz Poslanice Filipljanima, psalma i evanđelja po Luki (Lk 14,15-24) govornik naglašava da je spasenje moguće jedino po Isusu Kristu. Upozorava na masone i pokret New Age, koje opisuje kao pokušaj stapanja svih religija, te prispodobu o velikoj večeri tumači kao poziv kršćanima koji se ispričavaju i ne odazivaju Bogu. Na kraju najavljuje promocije knjige »Isus lider« i predstavljanja domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora u više hrvatskih gradova te poziva na učlanjenje i donacije.
key_points: Govornik tvrdi da masoni i pokret New Age pokušavaju uvjeriti kršćane i crkvenu hijerarhiju da su sve religije od Boga i da ih treba stopiti u jednu. New Age opisuje kao mješavinu kršćanstva, islama, hinduizma, budizma i poganskih vjerovanja te kao sotoninu religiju za novo doba.

Smatra da je završava jedno biblijsko doba od oko 2000 godina. Poziva se na Gospine poruke iz Garabandala, Akite i Međugorja o novom dobu i trijumfu Marijina Bezgrešnog Srca te na »plavu knjigu« don Stefana Gobbija o konačnoj bitki dobra i zla.
Naglašava da nema drugih putova spasenja osim Isusa Krista. Govoriti da se ljudi mogu spasiti po drugim religijama naziva herezom.

Izražava čvrsto uvjerenje da će ljudima kojima Krist nije naviješten, a umrli su bez svoje krivnje, evanđelje biti naviješteno prije posljednjeg suda. Kao mogući način navodi svjedočanstvo svećenika sa stigmama kojem u snu dolaze duše muslimana.
Prema govorniku, zajedničke molitvene aktivnosti s drugim religijama imaju smisla samo ako njihovi pripadnici prvo priznaju da je Isus Krist Sin Božji. U suprotnom ih treba pustiti da rade svoje.

Prispodobu o velikoj večeri tumači tako da su uzvanici koji se ispričavaju poslom, imanjem i obitelji današnji kršćani koji se ne odazivaju na poziv za obraćenje. Pozvani s ulica i putova su pogani, muslimani, hindusi i budisti, a kao primjer navodi obraćenja u Africi.
Ističe da kršteni kršćani, koji mogu primati sakramente, imaju veću odgovornost i stroži sud od onih koji nisu primili kršćanstvo.

key_points_en: The speaker claims that Freemasons and the New Age movement are trying to convince Christians and the Church hierarchy that all religions are from God and that they should be merged into one. He describes New Age as a mixture of Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, and pagan beliefs, and as Satan's religion for a new age.

He believes that a biblical era of about 2000 years is ending. He refers to Our Lady's messages from Garabandal, Akita, and Međugorje about a new era and the triumph of Mary's Immaculate Heart, as well as to the »blue book« of Fr. Stefano Gobbi about the final battle between good and evil.
He emphasizes that there are no other paths of salvation besides Jesus Christ. Calling that people can be saved through other religions he labels heresy.

He expresses a firm conviction that people to whom Christ was not proclaimed, and who died through no fault of their own, will have the Gospel proclaimed to them before the final judgment. As a possible way, he cites the testimony of a priest with stigmata to whom the souls of Muslims come in a dream.

According to the speaker, joint prayer activities with other religions make sense only if their members first acknowledge that Jesus Christ is the Son of God. Otherwise, they should be left to do their own thing.

He interprets the parable of the great banquet in such a way that the guests who make excuses with work, property, and family are today's Christians who do not respond to the call to conversion. Those invited from the streets and pathways are pagans, Muslims, Hindus, and Buddhists, and as an example he cites conversions in Africa.
He points out that baptized Christians, who can receive the sacraments, have greater responsibility and a stricter judgment than those who have not received Christianity.

summary.title_en: 127. Divine Mercy - Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father!
summary.abstract_en: The episode is a prayer and catechetical show of the Oraetlabora Međugorje channel, which, according to the description, was prepared by Dr. Vladimir Grebenar. The first and longest part consists of prayers: invocation of protection and deliverance, consecrations to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus, the Chaplet and Litanies of Divine Mercy, and the sorrowful mysteries of Our Lady's Rosary with the Hail Holy Queen. In interpreting the reading from the Epistle to the Philippians, the psalm, and the Gospel according to Luke (Lk 14:15-24), the speaker emphasizes that salvation is possible only through Jesus Christ. He warns against Freemasons and the New Age movement, which he describes as an attempt to merge all religions, and interprets the parable of the great banquet as a call to Christians who make excuses and do not respond to God. At the end, he announces promotions of the book »Jesus the Leader« and presentations of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora in several Croatian cities, and calls for membership and donations.
